description: This file is a Next.js page component implementing a shop overview page. It defines static generation functions, handles route params, and renders links to related sections like invoices, customers, and payments for a specific shop.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static parameters for pre-rendering shop pages based on a predefined list of shop IDs.

methods.name: ShopOverviewPage
methods.description: React component that renders the shop overview page, displaying links to different shop management sections.
